FRONTEND: (1) Mobile sub-header at 390x844 is FIXED — title 'SPRINTC_UI Day tabs' fully rendered (scrollWidth==clientWidth, 20px font), '↩ BACK HOME' chip inline right of the title, date range on its own row, OWNER badge + 4 action icons on the top row inside the viewport, header inner height 110px, no horizontal overflow, no title/badge overlap. Desktop 1440 unchanged: header 117px, KM/Spend totals visible again, title+badge+icons in one band, no overflow, no truncation. (2) DnD collision fix is PARTIAL — the new compound detector IS shipped (verified 'pointerWithin' + the new comment inside static/js/src_components_trip_TripDayView_jsx.chunk.js) but wrong-day drops still reproduce ~40% of drags (3 clear failures out of 8): pointer on day-drop-2026-08-19 -> scheduled 2026-08-21; pointer on day-drop-2026-08-21 -> 2026-08-23 (twice); pointer on day-drop-2026-08-26 -> 2026-08-28. Root cause measured in-browser (see rca_of_the_issue): dnd-kit window auto-scroll moves the pill strip out from under the stationary pointer mid-drag (probe showed window.scrollY 0->45 and the target pill's y 836->791 while the pointer stayed at y=858), pointerWithin then returns [] and the compound detector falls through to rectIntersection/closestCenter, which is measured against the dragged card in the right-hand drawer (no DragOverlay is rendered) and therefore lands ~2 pills to the right — exactly the iteration_22 symptom. Passing drags were the ones where no scroll/layout shift happened during the drag. (3) Transit-day drop pill can never succeed: PATCH /attractions/{id}/schedule with a transit date returns 422 'No stop covers 2026-08-23 — assign a target_stop_id or pick another date.', yet TripDayView renders a 'Drop → 08-23' pill for it. BONUS: attr-date-input and expense-date-input both prefill 2026-08-22 from the selected day tab (PASS).

minor.issue: Transit days (no stop covering the date) return 422 by design, but the day-view exposes a drop target for them, so the UI offers an action that can never succeed. Either accept a derived/optional target_stop_id from the UI or the frontend must disable transit-day drop pills.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong-day drops still reproduce (~40% failure rate, 3/8 drags). The compound detector (pointerWithin > rectIntersection > closestCenter) is deployed, but dnd-kit's default window auto-scroll shifts the drop-pill strip up while the pointer stays still; once the pointer is outside every pill rect, pointerWithin returns [] and the rectIntersection/closestCenter fallback resolves against the translated dragged card (which sits in the right-side drawer, ~115px right of the cursor, and no DragOverlay is rendered), landing the drop ~2 day pills to the right. Measured evidence: pointer (1174,858) on day-drop-2026-08-26 -> announced/scheduled 2026-08-28, with window.scrollY 0->45 and pill y 836->791 during the drag.
A 'Drop → 08-23' pill is rendered for transit days; dropping there always fails with a 422 toast ('No stop covers 2026-08-23'). Disable/grey those pills (or pass a target_stop_id).

action_items: Harden the DnD target resolution in TripDayView: (a) disable auto-scroll on the DndContext (autoScroll={false} or a restricted config) so the pill strip cannot move under the cursor, (b) set measuring={{droppable:{strategy: MeasuringStrategy.Always}}} so mid-drag layout shifts are re-measured, and (c) make the fallback pointer-safe — return [] (no-op drop) instead of rectIntersection/closestCenter, or render a <DragOverlay> so the collision rect is centred on the cursor. Any single one of (a)/(c) removes the ~2-pill offset.
Disable transit-day drop pills (or send target_stop_id) — the drop currently always 422s.
Optional cleanup: DragOverlay is imported in TripDayView but never rendered; DndContext is imported in DayContent.jsx but not used.
critical_code_review_comments: The rectIntersection/closestCenter fallback in the compound collision detector defeats the purpose of the fix: whenever the pointer is not over a pill the drop silently schedules the WRONG day instead of being a no-op. Prefer failing closed.
Because no DragOverlay is rendered, the drag collision rect is the original card node inside the drawer, so any rect-based detector is inherently offset from the cursor by half the card width.

rca_of_the_issue: TripDayView renders the day drop pills only during drag, inside a strip that participates in normal page layout, and does NOT render a DragOverlay. dnd-kit's default auto-scroll fires while dragging near viewport edges: measured window.scrollY 0 -> 45 mid-drag, moving the target pill from y=836 to y=791 while the pointer remained at y=858 (i.e. outside every pill rect). pointerWithin therefore returns an empty array and the compound detector falls through to rectIntersection/closestCenter, which compare the translated rect of the dragged card — the card lives in the right-side drawer and is ~115px wide-offset from the grip the cursor holds — so the nearest pill by rect is about two pills (2 x 85px) to the right of the intended day. Mitigation: disable auto-scroll, re-measure droppables continuously (MeasuringStrategy.Always), and make the fallback a no-op rather than a rect-based guess (or add a DragOverlay so the collision rect follows the cursor).
